Archive Search is an add-on that allows you to extend the search period in the Debug Console from 30 days (i.e. the default period) to either 60 days or 90 days. This add-on feature can be availed on request. Reach out to your account manager for more details.

This feature provides the ability for the users to debug in a single interface with multiple filters available to query the transaction logs.
